title: Three POWERFUL words that make a difference
html:
I might have said this before, but words are powerful. The words you use to describe yourself, and your circumstances, define you, so make sure they are big, bold and inspirational.

The following words are words I really like: design, engineer and create. These three powerful words when used in any job, career or life make an amazing difference.

Here’s why:

Design: take time to design your life.
There is a common saying that people spend more time organising a party than their own life. Spend 10 minutes a week designing your life and you will be far ahead of the crowd. You will have spent almost 9 hours over the year. 9 hours, from just 10 minutes a week!

Engineer: engineer your life.
Sketch it out. Use your eraser and pencil to trim here or add there. When you’re happy with it, use ink and make it permanent. You now have a blueprint and a plan to follow.

Create: use your plan and start building.
Have you ever built a house or a model plane? That’s how detailed you need to get. Don’t think you can do this in just one sitting. Just 10 minutes a week though, at a set time, going over the plans and imagining what your life will look like in minute detail is exciting. You will feel like a kid again and have so much energy that nothing will be able to stop you.

Try it today. Doing this exercise helped me to change my attitude after a particularly hard day and reminded me of where I am going.
